messages:
Marco P: Quick FYI — final RN draft below. Planning to pin at 11:30PT and kick the DeployBot at 11:45. Need ops sign-off and DevEx microcopy check.

Lily W: reading now. looks small. Will confirm oncall availability.

Chris H: pinned model version? we should pin to `v2.3.4-pin` not `latest`.

Marco P: yes — pin `redwood/model-llama-2:2026-03-18-v2.3.4` in release doc. added note about fallback to `v2.3.3-quant` if capacity issues.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] scheduled: release/2026-03-21 11:45PT — preflight checks queued.

ops-oncall: i'll be on standby. rollback lane: immediate rollback tag `rollback/2026-03-21-11` — if >3% error rate for 5m.

Janet (PM): add customer-facing blurb: "Performance improvements and safer mem usage; no customer action required." Keep short.

DevEx Bot: microcopy suggestion: use 'Notice: Performance improvements — no action needed.' Use CTA to docs: https://redwood.example/docs/release-notes

Lily W: small nit: add note about metrics dashboard (route=lm-pipelines) and the tracing flag `TRACE_MODEL_SWITCH=true`.

Marco P: updated draft below -> pushing final to internal channel at 11:30PT. Can someone paste the deploy command in ops channel 5m before?

Chris H: deploy command (ops): `./deploy --env=prod --image=redwood/model-llama-2:2026-03-18-v2.3.4 --pin=true --canary=5% --timeout=30m`

deploy-bot: preflight OK. infra checks: GPUs available=48, slots per node=4, registry auth OK.

ops-oncall: noted. I'll trigger canary monitor and alert if latency >150ms p50 or error spike detected.

Marco P: nailed it, thank you. final RN pasted below.

---

Marco P: [RELEASE NOTE DRAFT]
What's changing: model runtime & perf tuning (v2.3.4). Micro-optimizations to KV cache reduce tail latency.
Customer impact: minor; rolling update, no expected downtime.
When: 2026-03-21 11:45 PT (change window 30m)
Rollback plan: immediate revert to `v2.3.3-quant` + traffic pin to Dedicated pool. Automatic rollback if 5m error rate >3% or 15% latency regression p90.
Contact: ops-oncall and eng-releases channel.

---

Lily W: lgtm from ops side.

Janet (PM): lgtm from PM.

Chris H: ok from infra side. I'll run the canary timeline.

Marco P: thanks all. publishing internal announce at 11:30PT and will pin the RN. :thumbsup:

DevEx Bot: reminder — attach release link to docs and set internal retention tag `rn/2026-03-21`.

ops-oncall: going to sleep now; wake me 10m before deploy with @ops-oncall ping.

Marco P: will do. Thanks everyone :rocket:
